conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, holding a larger cash buffer. Expect lower potential gains but also a much lower chance of significant drawdowns.

Trim SPY to reduce broad index exposure and free up capital for income.
Significantly add to QQQI to maximize monthly income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month through steady distributions, prioritizing low drawdowns. It shifts heavily into income-generating assets like QQQI and reduces volatile growth stocks. While aiming for stable income, the Net Asset Value can still decline in market downturns.
